cfg.gaps: Free sources publish late: check the 'data to' date on each figure. The FRED data service sometimes returns a copy several days old; each update retries and keeps the newest reading it can get. October 2025 US consumer prices were never published, so the October 2026 year-on-year rate cannot be calculated. Coverage is US-heavy: euro-area, UK and China economic figures are not yet included. Live ship and aircraft positions are paid data and are not used. The WHO outbreak page and UKMTO incident page did not return current entries when tested, so those records appear only when a document is found directly.
